items.title: John Handy Interview, 1958-12-04
items.q: Working for Beansy at E-Lights at two clarinets, William for myself.

ctx.x: Yeah, he was working next door to Black and Tan. Working for Beansy at E-Lights at two clarinets, William for myself. Yeah, two clarinets.
How did that work out when you had two clarinets? How would you play? Would you read? Could you fake together? No, we'd fake together.
